entities.name: Mirian I of Iberia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mirian I was a king (mepe) of Iberia who reigned in the 2nd century BC. An adopted son of his father-in-law King Sauromaces I, he was a Persian-born prince but governed over Iberia as a member of the Pharnavazid dynasty.
